Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to SSIM

success_criteria.description: paper_exact has 24 checksum-verified Kodak images; a subset must be labelled course_fast.
PSNR, windowed SSIM, FLIP, LPIPS, and spectral metric versions are recorded per image.

A method comparison reports the paired distribution, not a mean delta alone: how many pairs were actually compared, how many were wins, ties and losses, and an interval. A mean with no count behind it cannot be distinguished from a mean over one pair.
success_criteria.evidence: results/image_repro_paired.json, fields count, ties, losses, ci95_low and ci95_high

success_criteria.description: A comparison that has not run must read as absent, never as a null result. The Table 1 pairings carry count 0, mean_delta null and complete false against expected_pairs 72; rendering that as a result, a tie, or a zero difference is a reporting defect. Print the achieved count beside the expected one so the gap is visible without opening the JSON.
success_criteria.evidence: results/image_repro_paired.json, fields complete, count and expected_pairs

success_criteria.description: An approval to spend compute traces to a human decision, and the process seeking approval never generates its own. This is not hypothetical here: an automated recovery policy fabricated an authorization receipt that represented earlier user intent as current independent approval, and relaunched four ranks against the canonical Table 1 namespace. Name who approved a run and where that approval is recorded.

readings.title: Random-Access Neural Compression of Material Textures

success_criteria.description: Every map has provider, asset ID, license, dimensions, color-space/normal convention, and checksum evidence.
A local proxy is labelled proxy and is not called RTXNTC-equivalent without official parity evidence.

Recompute Table 2 under a different map-category mix before comparing against the paper. The reported PSNR is a map-weighted mean, the eight categories span about 19 dB, and the methods are not equally strong on each, so reweighting changes both the level and the order. Report which method pairs swap. A comparison that skips this step is not a result.

Rule out compute and loss family before hunting for a mechanism. Both are cheap to test and both are the usual suspects, so an unexamined mechanism claim made while they are still open is not evidence. Here extra compute made the gap worse rather than better, which is what eliminated it.

A composition inferred from the observed gaps must be validated on data it was not fitted to. Refit it leaving one method out and report the held-out error against the starting error. Fitting alone proves only that enough free parameters were available; here the held-out RMS falls from 1.248 dB to 0.405 dB, and it is that ratio, not the fit, that carries the claim.
success_criteria.evidence: notebooks/W08_texture_ntc.ipynb section 6b and results/texture_repro/shortfall_analysis/implied_composition.json, fields our_composition_rms_db, leave_one_method_out_rms_db and held_out_improvement_factor

success_criteria.description: State in the same paragraph what the explanation does not cover. A mechanism that is sufficient on the instances that show the effect is not thereby general. The reduction ladder is monotone on paving-stones-070 and non-monotone on metal-plates-013, where the differential effect changes sign, so the honest claim is sufficiency where the reversal occurs and not a uniform mechanism. Reporting only the instance that worked does not pass.
success_criteria.evidence: results/texture_repro/ordering_probe/receipt.json, field answer and the monotone_in_normalisation_strength flags

readings.title: Local Positional Encoding for Multi-Layer Perceptrons

success_criteria.description: Lucy, Thai Statue, and Armadillo have source and checksum receipts for derived 512-cubed volumes; Pitted Stonefish remains an explicit authorization blocker until legitimately acquired, with no substitute.
Loss, sign convention, axis order, sampling, seeds, and per-instance IoU are explicit.

A blocked instance is recorded as evidence, not written off in prose. Name the exact asset, the authorization mechanism, proof that no access was attempted, and the job plan that would run the moment authorization arrived. A blocker documented to that standard is a result. 'We could not get it' is not.
State the budget before spending it: job count, total queries, per-job queries, and the memory floor one worker needs. A cost discovered afterwards cannot inform the decision it should have informed.
success_criteria.evidence: results/sdf_repro/cost.json, fields jobs, full_volume_queries, full_volume_queries_per_job and memory_floor_per_worker

success_criteria.description: After an interruption, outputs are not trusted merely because they exist. Before accepting them instead of re-running, verify that no partial files remain, that no related process is still writing, and that checksums and schema still hold, and record which of those was checked. This is distinct from a liveness check, which watches a run that is still going.
success_criteria.evidence: results/sdf_repro/volume_validation.json, fields recovery.partial_files_found, recovery.active_related_processes, recovery.action and checksums_verified

success_criteria.description: Close one measure-diagnose-change-remeasure cycle against the limiting resource. Required: the code object footprint before and after, output checksums shown unchanged, the speedup measured under the settled protocol, and a statement of what generality the change cost. success_criteria.description: Track, hypothesis, profile, metric, baseline value, seed, and evidence path are nonblank and finite where numeric.
The baseline is rerun under the selected profile rather than copied from a legacy CSV.

Any run that changes config or tracked source happens in a disposable clone, so the committed tree stays clean and earlier evidence keeps matching the files it cites. Name the clone that produced each number.
A run expected to last more than a few hours declares a liveness check that lives outside the run and asserts progress, not process existence: a monotone counter compared against wall-clock time.
